project.title: Masque Character Creator
project.summary: PF2e Remaster session-zero and character creator for The Masque of Shattered Mirrors—one player, one GM, spoiler-safe handoff.

items.title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript local-first app
items.notes: New app or monorepo sibling next to pf2e-point-buy-calc. Node 22.18+ or 24+. Exit: app runs locally.

items.title: Extract or copy attribute engine from pf2e-point-buy-calc
items.notes: Port options, normalizeBuild, ancestryRule, calculate, and serialize/parse. Do not reimplement boost math.

items.title: Add shared Build and SessionZero types
items.notes: Mechanical Build plus new SessionZero answers for invitation, stake, art, faith, mask.

items.title: Add Player / GM mode toggle with GM panel hidden by default
items.notes: Player-safe default; GM wiring only when toggled.

items.title: Port smoke tests for Remaster boost math
items.notes: Reuse or port test/build.test.ts from the point-buy calculator. Exit: empty shell loads a default level-1 build.

items.title: Ship player-safe invitation blurb and guided questions
items.notes: Why accept; who matters (or self as watched); art/craft; optional deity (Pharasma / Nocticula / Black Butterfly / none); mask concept. No ritual spoilers.

items.title: Persist session-zero answers in localStorage and export JSON/Markdown
items.notes: Player can finish questions and take answers with them.

items.title: Add soft table lines for etiquette and investigate-before-violence
items.notes: Player-facing tips only; Exit: player finishes questions without seeing GM secrets.

items.title: Port attribute creator UI from the point-buy calculator
items.notes: Ancestry / background / class / level / milestones / voluntary flaws. Player Core and Player Core 2 first; custom rows otherwise.

items.title: Make default start level configurable by the GM
items.notes: Confirm expected start level with the player before locking defaults (open decision).

items.title: Add share link and printable attribute ledger for the mechanical build
items.notes: Mechanical side only; Exit: full Remaster attribute planning works in-app.

items.title: Score builds against night demands (Will, Perception, social, Stealth/Thievery)
items.notes: Also cover Athletics climax interventions, optional Religion, Performance flavor. Same scores for player and GM.

items.title: Flag builds that lean hard into combat-as-default
items.notes: Not forbidden—flagged. Soft guidance over pure damage.

items.title: Suggest campaign-fit backgrounds and classes as hints not locks
items.notes: Backgrounds e.g. Artist, Entertainer, Noble, Acolyte, Detective; classes e.g. Bard, Rogue, Investigator, Oracle, Witch, Cleric, Swashbuckler.

items.title: Auto-generate spoiler-gated GM tailoring brief with copy-to-clipboard
items.notes: Stake→scapegoat wiring; art→Verathe framing; faith→deity lever; mask→Marius beat; key skills→NPC/room payoffs. Exit: leave session zero with a personalization plan.

items.title: Add level-appropriate skill increase planner mapped to campaign fit
items.notes: Remaster proficiency ranks. Optional language/lore notes; Osiriani Descent flavor stays GM-side only.

items.title: Ship single export package and import for prior exports
items.notes: Session-zero + attributes + skills + GM brief in one package.

items.title: Polish tone and CSS for a masquerade-adjacent readable UI
items.notes: Not a combat dashboard.

items.title: Fill README Run locally with real commands and ports
items.notes: Replace TBD port/deploy once implementation exists.

items.title: Optionally deploy static build like pf.starmist.studio
items.notes: Ready to hand a link to the player when desired.
